turns.text: Good afternoon, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client. Would it be possible to secure a table for two at 17:00 today?
Yes, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client
OK. We need a £20 card deposit to hold the table. Can you send the card details?
Let me just check that and come back to you in a moment.
Не давай картку. Скажи, що заплатимо на місці або нехай надішлють посилання на оплату.
Thank you, but we will settle the £20 deposit on the day; could you please send us a payment link instead?
No problem, we can waive it. Booked: The Wolseley, 17:00, two people.
Wonderful, thank you ever so much. Just to confirm the booking: a table for two (2 people) at 17:00 (5 pm) today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, at The Wolseley. We look forward to it. Many thanks again!
